subject: Clarify MAP evidence lifecycle and retention for SOC 2 / SIG
messages:
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@brightgate.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Chen <mchen@brightgate.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: SOC 2 / SIG evidence & retention clarifications

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the MAP you sent over earlier. Before we lock timelines with procurement, legal needs a quick pass on two things we flagged while reviewing the security/compliance section:

1) Evidence lifecycle: for SOC 2 controls and the SIG matrix, can you confirm which artifacts are expected to be retained in our tenancy vs. provided as time-bound extracts (e.g., 90-day snapshots)? We need to map that to our internal archival policy.

2) DPA & retention windows: the DPA draft currently lists a default 6-month log retention for transactional logs. Our privacy team prefers 30 days unless there is a contractual reason to extend. Is there flexibility here, and what are the operational impacts (cost/perf) if we agree to 30 vs 180 days?

3) SIG/CAIQ deliverables: the checklist calls for evidence for encrypted backups and key rotations. Can you point us to the artifacts (report names/paths) so we can reference them in our intake?

We're targeting an internal decision by Friday (8/9). If we can get commitments and an updated MAP row for evidence owners and timelines, procurement can finalize the SOW.

Appreciate a compact reply with owners and dates.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Lopez
Head of Information Security Programs
BrightGate Financial

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@brightgate.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 / SIG evidence & retention clarifications

Dana —

Thanks for the clear list. High level answers first, then an attached MAP update and proposed mini-runway for acceptance: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (attached) and a short evidence index (soc2-evidence-index.pdf).

1) Evidence lifecycle
- Short answer: we can provide extracted artifacts for most SOC 2 controls on a 90-day pull basis, with longer archival (up to 2 years) available via on-request export for contractual audit.
- Owner: Priyom (Compliance) will own extracts; Rishi (Platform) will confirm automated export cadence and cost.

2) DPA & retention windows
- Default operational retention for PII/transactional logs is configurable; 30 days is supported but requires:
  - Disabling certain historical analytics (affects debug traces for rare incidents)
  - Slightly higher compute during export windows if you request frequent on-demand pulls.
- Ops impact estimate: Priyom: ~+4% monthly infra cost for frequent extracts; Rishi: negligible latency change to serving.

3) SIG/CAIQ deliverables
- Evidence paths: backups and rotation evidence are in our secure evidence repo; see soc2-evidence-index.pdf page 4 for file names and brief descriptions. We will provide immutable snapshots for CAIQ items A.1–A.5.

Proposed acceptance timeline (embedded into MAP rows):
- 8/8 (EOD): Redwood sends updated MAP rows with owners & evidence links (we've attached a draft).
- 8/9 (noon): BrightGate internal review complete — final questions to be raised by Mark.
- 8/9 (EOD): Mutual sign-off on MAP evidence commitments, move to procurement to finalize SOW.

Attachments included: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (updated rows), soc2-evidence-index.pdf (artifact index).

If that schedule works, we'll mark Priyom as evidence owner and Rishi as ops owner in the MAP and follow up with the exact export procedures.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue & GTM Security (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@brightgate.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Aug 2029 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 / SIG evidence & retention clarifications

Dana / Kimberly —

Following up with the concrete owners and a slightly refined runbook:

- Evidence ownership (MAP row updates):
  • SOC 2 controls (CC1–CC7): Priyom (Compliance) — responsible for extracted artifact bundles, periodic attestations.
  • SIG/CAIQ network controls: Rishi (Platform Eng) — responsible for config snapshots, backup proofs, rotation logs.
  • DPA retention items: Legal (BrightGate) to confirm preferred retention; Redwood supports 30/90/180-day options.

- Technical runbook summary (what we'll deliver):
  1) ZIP export of control evidence (per control) — retained in an S3 export bucket for 30 days by default; can be extended on request. Attachment stub: soc2-evidence-index.pdf (lists file names).
  2) Key rotation proof: rotation logs + KMS policy snapshot (will be delivered as immutables).
  3) Backup encryption proof: backup config + periodic verification report.

- Cost/operational note for 30d vs 180d retention:
  • 30-day: minimal cost, recommended for privacy-sensitive customers.
  • 180-day: adds storage and occasional retrieval costs; we estimate a marginal increase of ~3–6% depending on export frequency.

Action items:
- Kimberly: finalize MAP row edits and re-issue (Kim will attach to this thread).
- Dana/Mark: confirm retention preference (30 vs 180 days) and whether you want automatic archive exports sent quarterly.

I'll also schedule a 30-minute clarifying call for 8/8 16:00 PT if that helps.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Director, Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Mark Chen <mchen@brightgate.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@brightgate.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Aug 2029 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: SOC 2 / SIG evidence & retention clarifications

Kimberly / Priyom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. BrightGate legal & privacy discussed and we are comfortable with the following (summary acceptance):

• Retention: We will proceed with 30-day default retention for transactional logs, with a contractual option in the SOW to extend to 180 days for specific event buckets (e.g., fraud traces).
• Evidence delivery: We accept per-control extracted bundles on a 90-day snapshot cadence; BrightGate reserves the right to request ad-hoc exports for audits (handled as part of the SOW).
• SIG/CAIQ references: the artifact names in soc2-evidence-index.pdf are sufficient for intake; request only that Redwood include the KMS policy snapshot in the CAIQ package.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Kimberley: publish final MAP rows reflecting owners and dates (please attach final MAP to the procurement PO).
2) Redwood: include a short SOW appendix for retention options (30/90/180) and a cost table for each.
3) BrightGate: procurement will draft the SOW to include the appendix and send redlines by 8/13.

We can proceed on that basis. Thanks again — this keeps our timelines intact.

Mark Chen
Senior Counsel, BrightGate Financial
